title: Italian tomato and bean skillet
text: Italian white beans, tomato, garlic and olive oil make a quick skillet meal. Soften garlic gently, simmer tomatoes, then warm cooked beans. Finish with basil. Mash a few beans to thicken the sauce.

title: Finishing Italian pasta
text: Italian pasta with tomato, spinach or mushrooms benefits from a little reserved starchy pasta water. Finish the pasta in the sauce and add water gradually to coat it. Add delicate basil near the end.

title: Indian chickpea tomato curry
text: For an Indian chickpea curry, soften onion in oil, briefly toast cumin, then add tomato and ground spices. Simmer cooked chickpeas in the sauce. Finish with lemon. Do not burn dry spices.

title: Indian red lentils
text: Indian red lentils can simmer with turmeric and water until soft. Rinse lentils first and stir as they thicken. A separate seasoning of gently toasted cumin and garlic adds aroma.

title: Mexican bean tacos
text: Mexican-style tacos can use cooked black beans, tomato, onion, cumin and tortillas. Mash some beans for texture, warm tortillas separately, and add fresh lime just before serving.

title: Mexican-style tomato rice
text: For Mexican-style rice, gently toast raw rice in oil before adding tomato and measured stock. Cover and simmer until the rice absorbs the liquid. Rest off the heat before fluffing.

title: Mediterranean chickpea salad
text: Mediterranean chickpea salad combines cooked chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, lemon and olive oil. Drain chickpeas well and cut vegetables into similar pieces. Dress shortly before serving for a crisp texture.

title: Mediterranean roasted vegetables
text: Mediterranean zucchini, bell pepper and eggplant roast well with olive oil and oregano. Cut evenly and leave space on the tray so the vegetables brown. Finish with lemon and serve with cooked grains.

title: East Asian-inspired tofu stir-fry
text: For an East Asian-inspired tofu and broccoli stir-fry, pat firm tofu dry and brown it first. Stir-fry broccoli separately, add ginger, then a little soy sauce and water. Return tofu at the end.

title: East Asian-inspired vegetable noodles
text: East Asian-inspired noodles pair with cabbage, carrot, ginger and soy sauce. Prepare all ingredients before cooking. Cook vegetables over brisk heat and toss with cooked noodles. Add sauce in small amounts.
